about.title: Farmersville Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Farmersville is a small city, but its roads still see a steady flow of traffic accidents. Recent public records show 19 injury collisions in a single year, with 28 people hurt and one traffic death — numbers that reflect real families dealing with pain, medical bills, and missed work. Corridors like Farmersville Boulevard, North Farmersville Boulevard, and Visalia Road account for a large share of reported crashes, and Friday afternoons between 4 and 6 p.m. tend to see the most activity. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the choices you make in the days afterward matter. LawProactive is a free connection service — not a law firm — that can put you in touch with an independent personal injury attorney familiar with Tulare County claims. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost, and no fee unless you recover compensation.

whyChoose.title: Why Farmersville Residents Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Time Limits Matter
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the crash date to file a claim, but if a government entity (like a city road crew) was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Acting early helps preserve your options.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Reduce, Not Erase, Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash — your compensation is simply adjusted to reflect your share of fault.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering
items.desc: Unlike some states, California doesn't limit non-economic damages such as pain and suffering in most car accident cases, which is why documenting how the crash affected your daily life matters.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim. An independent attorney can help you understand what, if anything, you're required to say.

items.question: What should I do about evidence from a crash on Farmersville Boulevard or Visalia Road?
items.answer: Try to preserve photos, witness contact information, and any dashcam footage as soon as possible, since roadway conditions and vehicle damage can change quickly. Police reports and medical records from the crash also help establish what happened. The sooner this evidence is gathered, the stronger your claim tends to be.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing upfront. LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no obligation to move forward after speaking with an attorney.
